analyticalQuestion: Which company-metric histories have at least three comparable recent annual periods?
comparabilityRequirements: No layer-wide or market-wide financial totals.
Annual and interim observations are not mixed.
Missing and withheld values remain unavailable, not zero.
Company-wide financial observations are not AI-specific allocations.
limitationText: Histories are only included where at least three comparable annual periods exist; withheld and unavailable metrics remain excluded.
metricDefinition: Recent FY2023+ annual company-wide histories with directly comparable periods.
